input: Figure out my Myers-Briggs type properly

gold.taskTitle: Figure Out My Myers-Briggs Type Properly
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to accurately determine their Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) personality type through a thorough and reliable process.

questions.title: Have you taken an MBTI test before, and what was your result?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior experience with MBTI assessments.

questions.title: Why do you feel your previous result was not accurate?
questions.description: Identify what is driving the user's desire to re-examine their type.

questions.title: Which specific letter pairs feel most uncertain or confusing to you?
questions.description: Pinpoint the dimensions (E/I, S/N, T/F, J/P) where the user feels least confident.

questions.title: Do you want a free online test or a certified professional assessment?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a self-guided or formally administered approach.

questions.title: Are you open to reading about each type to self-identify?
questions.description: Gauge whether the user is willing to use type descriptions as a tool for self-reflection.

questions.title: What do you want to use your MBTI result for?
questions.description: Understand the end goal, such as career guidance, relationship insight, or self-awareness.

questions.title: How much time are you willing to spend on this process?
questions.description: Establish a time constraint to tailor the depth and method of the plan.
